title: AV Resident / Onsite Professional
description:
**Job Description: AV Resident / Onsite Professional**

**Role Overview**

As an **Onsite AV Resident Professional**, you will be comprehensively responsible for organizing, troubleshooting, and managing advanced media equipment across the facility. This includes active/curved LED screens, Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR) solutions, Yealink \& Panacast BYOD setups, and fully automated Training rooms, Boardrooms, and AV Experience Centers.

This role requires **in\-depth technical capabilities** to manage automated AV infrastructure, paired with **excellent technical communication skills** to interact with senior leadership teams during walkthroughs, demonstrations, and high\-profile events.

**Key Details**

· **Experience Required:** 4 to 8 years as an AV Technician and Audio Engineer

· **Education:** Diploma in Engineering or a similar technical field

· **Core Competencies:** AVC solutions, Microsoft MTR, IP Networking, Live Production, Stakeholder Management

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Infrastructure Management \& Technical Support**

· **Setup \& Operations:** Install, configure, and operate video monitors, sound systems, microphones, lighting, mixing boards, and active LED screens.

· **Ground Support:** Provide "hands and feet" troubleshooting, ground\-level break\-fixing, and back\-end technical support for meetings and events.

· **Upgrades \& Maintenance:** Lead ground\-level execution for new installations, faulty equipment replacements, equipment additions/removals, and software/firmware upgrades.

· **Preventive Checks:** Perform daily room audits, connectivity checks, and preventative maintenance checklists to ensure the AV system is 100% bug and snag\-free.

· **Network \& Control:** Manage, tune, and operate integrated Audio/Video Control (AVC) solutions and IP networking setups.

**Event Management \& Executive Support**

· **Event Execution:** Plan, test, and run the AV technology for high\-quality events connecting remote global participants (e.g., Town Halls, All Hands Meetings, Executive Boardrooms, Global Training, Live Concerts, and Conventions).

· **Leadership Walkthroughs:** Coordinate end\-to\-end planning and dry\-runs for senior leadership and client walkthroughs.

· **Pre\-Event Preparation:** Capture event requirements directly from the Business team and execute comprehensive dry\-runs prior to the scheduled start.

· **Business Continuity:** Run ground\-level business continuity drills and ensure all rooms feature up\-to\-date user manuals and posters.**Stakeholder Coordination**

· **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with the Program, Admin, and IT teams to swiftly implement functionality changes or address infrastructure bugs.

· **User Management:** Work directly with end\-user business teams to translate event concepts into professional audio, video, and live\-streaming production.

**Qualifications \& Technical Skills**

· **Technical Knowledge:** Deep familiarity with computer systems, IP networking, MTR setups, and AVC systems.

· **Troubleshooting:** Exceptional proactive diagnostics and timely resolution of complex equipment malfunctions.

· **Soft Skills:** Dynamic personality with strong managing capabilities, excellent interpersonal skills, and professional communication suited for executive leadership interaction.

Work Location: In person

title: Desktop & Network Support Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**  
We are looking for an **L1 IT / Network Support Engineer** to provide first\-level technical support for day\-to\-day IT infrastructure and network operations at the customer location.

The engineer will be responsible for monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving basic IT, endpoint, network, and security\-related issues, while escalating complex incidents to the appropriate L2/L3 teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide **L1 technical support** for desktops, laptops, printers, network connectivity, and other IT infrastructure.
* Monitor network and security infrastructure and identify alerts or service disruptions.
* Troubleshoot basic **LAN/WAN, Wi\-Fi, Internet and connectivity\-related issues**.
* Perform basic troubleshooting of switches, routers, firewalls and access points.
* Support user onboarding/offboarding, system configuration and basic access\-related requests.
* Troubleshoot Windows OS, Microsoft 365, email, applications and endpoint\-related issues.
* Assist with installation, configuration and maintenance of IT hardware and software.
* Monitor endpoint/security alerts and escalate incidents as per defined procedures.
* Perform basic checks on antivirus/EDR and other security solutions.
* Log, update and track incidents and service requests through the designated **ticketing system**.
* Maintain proper documentation of incidents, troubleshooting steps and resolutions.
* Follow defined **SOPs, escalation matrix and SLA requirements**.
* Coordinate with L2/L3 support teams, OEMs and other service providers whenever required.
* Maintain an inventory of IT assets and support documentation.
* Provide regular updates on open incidents and pending issues to the reporting manager/customer SPOC.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Good understanding of **TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN/WAN and Wi\-Fi**.
* Basic knowledge of **network switches, routers, firewalls and VPN**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Windows operating systems and Microsoft 365**.
* Basic understanding of endpoint security, antivirus/EDR and security best practices.
* Basic troubleshooting skills for hardware, software and network issues.
* Familiarity with IT ticketing/helpdesk systems.
* Good understanding of incident management and escalation processes.

**Desired Skills**

* Experience in an **enterprise IT support / NOC / helpdesk environment**.
* Exposure to network/security monitoring tools.
* Knowledge of any firewall platform such as **Sophos, SonicWall, Fortinet, Cisco, etc.**
* ITIL Foundation or relevant networking certification such as **CCNA** would be an advantage.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving approach.
* Good verbal and written communication.
* Ability to interact professionally with end users and customer teams.
* Good documentation and reporting skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as with remote L2/L3 teams.
* Willingness to learn and work in a customer\-facing environment.

**Key Performance Areas**

* Timely response and resolution of L1 incidents.
* Adherence to agreed **SLA and escalation timelines**.
* Effective monitoring and identification of infrastructure issues.
* Accurate ticket updates and documentation.
* Reduction of recurring incidents through proper troubleshooting and escalation.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Experience:

* network switches: 2 years (Preferred)
* firewalls : 2 years (Preferred)
* IT infrastructure: 2 years (Preferred)

License/Certification:

* CCNA certificate (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Field Engineer – IT
description:
**Core Responsibilities**


* Install, configure, test, and maintain IT infrastructure at customer locations and onboard vessels.
* Manage and troubleshoot servers, virtual machines (VMs), domains, and Remote Desktop Services (RDS).
* Troubleshoot LAN/WAN, routing, network connectivity, and other network issues.
* Install, configure, and troubleshoot firewalls and resolve connectivity and security issues.
* Support endpoint security, EDR, and antivirus installation and troubleshooting.
* Set up and troubleshoot computers, printers, scanners, and other IT hardware and peripherals.

* Handle onsite technical issues independently, coordinate with customers and internal teams, and provide timely issue resolution.

title: Electronics Engineer
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Electronics \& Communication Engineer** with hands\-on experience in **shipbuilding/ship repair**, particularly in **EM Log systems, marine electronics, and engine automation systems**. The candidate will be responsible for installation, commissioning, testing, troubleshooting, and maintenance of electronic, communication, navigation, and automation systems onboard vessels.

Key Responsibilities

* Installation, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of **marine electronic and automation systems**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Electromagnetic Log (EM Log) systems**, including sensor installation, cabling, calibration, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Experience in **main engine and auxiliary engine automation systems**.
* Installation and commissioning of engine monitoring and control systems.
* Troubleshoot **PLC, control panels, sensors, transmitters, actuators, alarms, and indication systems**.
* Work with engine automation systems such as:
* Engine control and monitoring systems
* Alarm and monitoring systems
* Remote control systems
* Safety and shutdown systems
* RPM/speed monitoring
* Temperature and pressure monitoring
* Level and flow measurement systems
* Read and interpret **electrical/electronic drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, and cable schedules**.
* Carry out cable termination, continuity checks, insulation testing, loop checking, and signal verification.
* Interface with **PLC, HMI, sensors, actuators, control panels, and communication networks**.
* Support installation and troubleshooting of marine communication and navigation equipment.
* Coordinate with **shipyard production, electrical, mechanical, commissioning, and QA/QC teams**.
* Coordinate with OEM/service engineers during installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting.
* Conduct harbour and sea trials and rectify system\-related observations.
* Prepare commissioning reports, test records, inspection reports, and system documentation.
* Ensure all work complies with **approved drawings, manufacturer recommendations, vessel specifications, class requirements, and applicable marine standards**.
* Follow shipyard safety procedures and ensure safe working practices onboard vessels.

Required Technical Knowledge

* Strong knowledge of **marine electronics and instrumentation**.
* Practical experience with **EM Log / Electromagnetic Speed Log**.
* Good understanding of **engine automation and control systems**.
* Knowledge of **PLC, HMI, I/O systems, sensors, transmitters, relays, control panels, and automation networks**.
* Familiarity with communication protocols such as **Modbus, CAN, RS\-485, Ethernet, and other marine communication interfaces**.
* Ability to troubleshoot electrical/electronic signals and control circuits.
* Knowledge of marine navigation and communication systems will be an added advantage.
* Ability to understand **P\&ID, wiring diagrams, single\-line diagrams, control schematics, and instrumentation drawings**.

Qualification

* **B.E./B.Tech in Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE)** or equivalent qualification.
* Candidates with a Diploma in Electronics/Electrical/Instrumentation Engineering with strong relevant shipbuilding experience may also be considered.
* **3–7 years of relevant experience**, preferably in shipbuilding, ship repair, marine automation, or vessel commissioning.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with practical experience in the following will be preferred:

* **EM Log installation and commissioning**
* Main Engine Automation
* Auxiliary Engine Automation
* Marine Alarm \& Monitoring Systems
* PLC\-based control systems
* Marine instrumentation
* Vessel commissioning and sea trials
* Navigation and communication systems
* Shipbuilding/ship repair projects

Key Skills

* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills
* Good technical communication
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings
* Ability to work independently onboard vessels
* Good coordination with OEMs, shipyard teams, and vessel crew
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality
* Willingness to work in **dock, shipyard, engine room, and onboard vessel environments**

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person
